newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Deng donates parts of body to medicine.
newsitem.headline: China's Deng donates parts of body to medicine.

text.p: China's late paramount leader Deng Xiaoping has donated parts of his body, including his corneas, to medicine and his ashes will be scattered in the sea, the Funeral Committee said on Thursday.
Deng's corneas would be donated, the family and the Funeral Committee said in statements issued by the Xinhua news agency.
Parts of his body would be given to medical research.

"The ashes would not be kept but in accordance with the wishes of Comrade Deng Xiaoping, the ashes will be scattered at sea," the family said in a statement signed by his widow, two sons and three daughters.
"We hope that the last thing we will do for Comrade Xiaoping....will be to demonstrate our grief in a simple and dignified way," the family's statement said.
